policies.label: Quality First
policies.description: Prefer the strongest outcome while still rewarding healthy, auditable providers.

policies.label: Cost Aware
policies.description: Reduce spend while preserving a quality floor and provider health.

policies.label: Private / Local
policies.description: Forbid remote transfer and keep eligible execution on local or first-party providers.

policies.label: Balanced
policies.description: General-purpose route balancing quality, privacy, speed, cost, and health.

policies.label: Regulated / Governed
policies.description: Strongly favor healthy, privacy-compatible providers and reject degraded state.
